parameters.name: eventID
parameters.description: An eventID to get Event data for. If an eventID has since changed, the Event which lists it in its aliases is returned

parameters.name: eventIDs
parameters.description: A comma separated list of eventIDs to get Event data for. If an eventID has since changed, the Event which lists it in its aliases is returned

parameters.name: sportID
parameters.description: A sportID or comma-separated list of sportIDs to get Events for

parameters.name: leagueID
parameters.description: A leagueID or comma-separated list of leagueIDs to get Events for

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only include Events of the specified type

parameters.name: oddsAvailable
parameters.description: Whether you want only Events which do (true) or do not (false) have odds markets which are currently available (open for wagering)

parameters.name: oddsPresent
parameters.description: Whether you want only Events which do (true) or do not (false) have any associated odds markets regardless of whether those odds markets are currently available (open for wagering)

parameters.name: oddID
parameters.description: An oddID or comma-separated list of oddIDs to include odds for

parameters.name: includeOpposingOdds
parameters.description: Whether to include opposing odds for each included oddID

parameters.name: includeAltLines
parameters.description: Whether to include alternate lines in the odds byBookmaker data

parameters.name: expandResults
parameters.description: Whether to expand the results object to include all stat values rather than just the base set

parameters.name: includeOpenCloseOdds
parameters.description: Whether to include open and close odds values (openOdds, closeOdds, openSpread, closeSpread, openOverUnder, closeOverUnder) in the odds byBookmaker data

parameters.name: bookmakerID
parameters.description: A bookmakerID or comma-separated list of bookmakerIDs to include odds for

parameters.name: teamID
parameters.description: A teamID or comma-separated list of teamIDs to include Events for

parameters.name: playerID
parameters.description: A playerID or comma-separated list of playerIDs to include Events (and associated odds) for

parameters.name: finalized
parameters.description: Only include finalized Events (true), exclude unfinalized Events (false) or all Events (omit)

parameters.name: live
parameters.description: Only include live Events (true), only non-live Events (false) or all Events (omit)

parameters.name: started
parameters.description: Only include Events which have have previously started (true), only Events which have not previously started (false) or all Events (omit)

parameters.name: ended
parameters.description: Only include Events which have have ended (true), only Events which have not ended (false) or all Events (omit)

parameters.name: cancelled
parameters.description: Only include cancelled Events (true), only non-cancelled Events (false) or all Events (omit)

parameters.name: startsAfter
parameters.description: Get Events that start after this date

parameters.name: startsBefore
parameters.description: Get Events that start before this date

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of Events to return

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The cursor for the request. Used to get the next group of Events. This is an opaque token — pass the nextCursor value from the prior response unchanged.

notice.description: Optional notice about filtered data due to API key limitations
notice.example: Response is missing 5 events and 12 bookmaker odds. Upgrade your API key to access all data from this query.
